Title: Draft Journal
Evidence: Live-gateway certified (Final-R0 Batch C). CRITICAL defect found and fixed (commit 72c4fb4): every draft-lifecycle write (create/update/validate/post/void) used Prisma's interactive $transaction(async tx=>...) form, but the RLS middleware's SET app.current_tenant_id ran on the base client's pooled connection, NOT the transaction's own dedicated connection — causing a 100%-reproducible 42501 RLS violation on every write. Fixed by setting the tenant context on the transaction's own connection as the first statement of every interactive transaction (draft-service.ts x6, reversal-service.ts x1). Evidence: positive create (201), validation failure (400, bad entryDate), unauthorized (401), cross-tenant denial (403), real persistence + readback via GET and psql (manual_je_draft), audit evidence confirmed (entity_type='MANUAL_JE_DRAFT', action='DRAFT_CREATED'), centralized S207 authorization, migration reproducibility confirmed.
